标题、信息和按钮层次清晰
边距充足，文字在画布内且不重叠，自行车可辨识
rubricEn: All six exact Chinese strings appear once
Clear hierarchy of heading, details and button
Adequate margins, no clipping or overlaps, recognizable bicycle

official.titleZh: LongCat 2.5 官方 benchmark 看板
official.captionZh: 官方选取的指标看板，未由本站复现。完整表格中带星号为引用分数，其余为美团自测。Terminal Bench 使用 Claude Code 2.1.280、512K；v2.1 为三次均值；BrowseComp 使用自研 harness。各榜条件不同。
official.captionEn: Vendor-selected overview, not independently reproduced. Stars in the full table identify cited scores; other scores are Meituan measurements. Terminal Bench uses Claude Code 2.1.280 and 512K, with v2.1 averaged over three runs; BrowseComp uses a custom harness. Conditions differ across tasks.
